name: classconnect
description: ClassConnect — Online Learning Platform for Cameroon (SRS-CC-CM-001 v1.0)

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @classconnect/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @classconnect/shared && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/db && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/api && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @classconnect/api && npm run test --workspace @classconnect/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.serverless.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.spec.json
